key.name: color
key.summary: Tint color
key.description: The color laid over the blur, or the plain color while the blur is off.

key.name: text-color
key.summary: The color of the text and symbolic icons on what this extension draws
key.description: The tiles behind them, such as calendar days and notification cards, are shades of it.

key.name: opacity
key.summary: Tint strength
key.description: The tint color's opacity over the blur. At 1, the blur does not show.

key.name: blur
key.summary: Blur what is behind the bars, menus, notifications and popups

key.name: blur-style
key.summary: Blur style
key.description: smooth is an even, gaussian-like blur; fast takes fewer samples and can look a little blocky at high strengths; frosted is smooth with a fine grain over it.

key.name: blur-radius
key.summary: Blur strength (px)
key.description: About how far the blur spreads each point.

key.name: top-bar-enabled
key.summary: Top bar grows out of the screen edge

key.name: top-bar-style
key.summary: Top bar style
key.description: center shrinks the bar to its buttons; pill keeps the monitor's width less the side margin.

key.name: top-bar-margin
key.summary: Side margin of the pill style (px)

key.name: top-bar-width
key.summary: Width of the centered style (px)
key.description: 0 shrinks the bar to its buttons. A larger width spreads them apart; the bar is never narrower than its buttons nor wider than the monitor.

key.name: top-bar-padding
key.summary: Room beside the outermost buttons (px)

key.name: top-bar-height
key.summary: Height (px)

key.name: top-bar-radius
key.summary: Radius of the outward-rounded corners (px)

key.name: top-bar-flare
key.summary: Radius of the inward-curved flares at the screen edge (px)

key.name: top-bar-in-dock
key.summary: Hide the top bar and put its buttons in Dash to Dock
key.description: On docks along the top or bottom of the screen. Without one, the top bar stays.

key.name: dock-bar-order
key.summary: The order of the top bar's buttons in the dock
key.description: The buttons' names in the top bar, from left to right. Those before "apps" go left of the dock's apps, the others right of them. Buttons not listed yet are added next to the apps.

key.name: dock-bar-hidden
key.summary: The top bar's buttons left out of the dock
key.description: Their names, as in the order. They are hidden while the top bar's buttons are in the dock.

key.name: hidden-indicators
key.summary: The icons left off the control center button
key.description: The names of the shell's fields that hold them, without the underscore (network, volumeInput, powerProfiles...), and "others" for those other extensions add. The control center keeps their entries.

key.name: dock-enabled
key.summary: Dash to Dock grows out of the screen edge

key.name: dock-space-edge
key.summary: Space between the apps and the screen edge (px)

key.name: dock-space-far
key.summary: Space on the apps' other side (px)

key.name: dock-radius
key.summary: Radius of the outward-rounded corners (px)

key.name: dock-flare
key.summary: Radius of the inward-curved flares at the screen edge (px)

key.name: menus-grow
key.summary: Top bar menus grow out of the bar

key.name: dock-menus-grow
key.summary: Dock menus grow out of the dock

key.name: dock-previews
key.summary: Hovering an app on the dock shows its window previews
key.description: Dash to Dock's preview menu, in place of the app's name, for apps with windows.

key.name: notifications-grow
key.summary: Notifications grow out of the top bar
key.description: Or out of the screen edge while the bar is hidden.

key.name: osd-grow
key.summary: Volume and brightness popup grows out of the top bar
key.description: Or out of the screen edge while the bar is hidden.

key.name: hidden-clock
key.summary: Draw Hide Top Bar: Multi Monitors' hidden clock tab in this color

key.name: notification-center-max-height
key.summary: The notification center's maximum height (px)
key.description: Its notifications scroll past this. It always stops short of a dock along the bottom of the screen.

key.name: surface-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of menus, notifications and the popup (px)
